decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans and information submitted (WP3693-G-EX and WP4088-G-SS received 08.08.11.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted is brought into use, provision shall be made for disabled people to gain access to 1 Lawrence Parade including level access from Swan Street and electronically operated self-opening doors.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted D1 use purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times Monday to Fridays 8am to 8pm and 8am to 6pm on Saturdays.
description: Variation of Condition 3 of planning permission 01101/D1/P1 for the change of use of the ground floor to D1 (non-residential institution) to use as a medical clinic dated 27/09/2011 to extend Saturday opening hours to 8am to 6pm.
